items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Joe Thomas) is narrating a story about another musician ('He') and his wife May. The interviewee mentions May only in the context of receiving money left for her ('allowed us both to leave something for May and Willy so they could get home'). There is no evidence of a direct persona

ctx.x: Yes. And his wife, May, and I think they were living out of Minneapolis. They knew some people in Minneapolis with some musical ideas so we all broke. And May is sick so he said well, I'm going to call Minneapolis. I know a band leader up there by the name of Eli Rice. Out of this Al Lewis (?) band and Darrell Harris' band -- Darrell Harris' band was the Black Diamond Orchestra.
